params.topic: Serie A Italy 2021-2025 historical bookmaker odds gap recovery
questions: For Italian Serie A seasons 2021/22 through 2025/26, identify public, verifiable historical sources that can provide row-level 1X2 and total-goals odds for Bet365, Pinnacle, and William Hill, keeping bookmakers separate.

Prioritize opening and closing/pre-match snapshots and sources with stable matching by season, kickoff date, home team, and away team. Return source URL, field semantics, timestamp semantics, and whether data is truly row-level historical rather than documentation only.

Assess whether a same-bookmaker opening and closing pair can support O_INTERVAL under strict provenance rules. Do not infer missing odds, do not convert closing to opening, do not use API-Football as bookmaker odds, and do not merge ambiguous fixtures.

Return structured JSON with source coverage, bookmaker availability, season coverage, expected matchability, unavailable/blocked reasons, and any concrete rows only when independently verifiable. Explicitly report coverage counts, unmatched counts, duplicate/conflict counts, and whether opening and closing values are separately present.
